title: Exclude fixed-peer two-ADD P104 retiming windows
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator remains #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with the signed #7113 caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

Contracting one of four fixed paid pairs could save at most 0.08583213854035211 raw in the complete 17-copy invoice. The compatible four-edit relaxation is at most 0.34332855416140845. One added raw rank-one paid position erases the entire allowance.

The original peer's strict ascent excludes all 4,124 A-side cuts. Independent forward and reverse walks agree on all 4,124 C-side cuts, every relevant peer MOVE and every first blocker. Zero cuts put the peer at C. There are 2,364 scalar-clean wrong-chart cuts and 1,760 wrong-chart cuts crossing an ADD. All 8,248 typed cuts are closed. No case remains unresolved in this scope.

## Task and overlap

The exact scientific inputs are bound to canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The research commit adds only `research/p104-fixed-peer-two-add-retime-bound/`. It is stacked on the two existing #7257 CI repair commits. On canonical main, the navigation test expects the #7000 replay and the CI guide still points to #6030. The package replay and source-history check pass on canonical main independently of that mismatch.

This changes the scope of task `p104-side-correction` to four fixed-peer, two-ADD chronology windows. #7338 inventories all four exact pairs under a virtual-owned fusion contract. This result establishes the separate fixed-public-peer endpoint obstruction.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-fixed-peer-two-add-retime-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay regenerates the directed price and both literal walks, reconciles every interval and contact, and rejects altered price and word. Add `--out fresh-directory` to retain all four receipts. Registered-package, committed-byte/source-history, navigation and export checks passed on the submitted stack. No candidate or full multiplier replay applies to this exclusion.

## Credit and open next questions

#7334 and #7113 supply the word and signed caller. #7338 supplies the overlapping inventory. #7365, #7362 and #7298 supply inherited contact, stock and price receipts. #7003, #7004, #7312, #7366 and #7368 supply chronology precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

The next distinct question is whether existing cocharted public rows can reproduce the two ADD inputs at their original clocks, using the post-first value at the second. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
